description: A Karplus-Strong string: a short delay line fed with noise or with audio and damped a little on each pass, which rings at a pitch set by the delay length.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves that pitch.
The pitch the string rings at.
How much of the audio input goes into the string.
How much the GAIN jack moves that input level.
How quickly the string dies away.
How much high frequency is lost on each pass round the string.
Sets what is fed into the string: up takes the input as it stands, middle takes the difference between one sample and the next, down takes the sine of that difference.

inputs.text: Plucks the string with a burst of noise on each rising edge.
Moves the input level into the string, by as much as the MOD knob beside GAIN allows.
Sets the pitch of the string at one volt per octave.
Moves the string's pitch, by as much as the MOD knob beside FQ allows.
Audio fed into the string instead of, or as well as, the noise burst.
Sets the level of what goes into the string.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
An unpatched modulation CV jack does not read 0V: the firmware drives it from an internal chaotic generator, so a MOD knob turned up with nothing patched lets a wandering voltage through.
The string is silent until something excites it: send a gate to PLK for a plucked note, or patch audio into IN.
